protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In the affected Ollama chat path, attacker-controlled model/server content is rendered by MarkdownItAsync with html: true, returned through the md.render IPC call, and assigned to Vue v-html. Raw event-handler HTML therefore executes in the Electron renderer, whose preload exposes FlyEnvNodeAPI.ipcSendToMain; AppNodeFn.exec_exec provides the demonstrated command-execution endpoint. CVE-2026-69116 is PUBLISHED and the GitHub advisory is not withdrawn.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed d0259bcabf37947f9a2e27a60a26bddef95f2b57. The commit first adds src/render/util/markdown/markdown.ts with MarkdownItAsync({ html: true }) and rewires Ollama/content.vue to createMarkdownRenderer, completing the advisory's raw-HTML XSS mechanism. Exact-line blame and -S history identify this commit; later relocation commits are not first-writes.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed against real parent 036c0e93e3078572ce89e89fac0bdaca614cd2f4. The parent has the Ollama v-html sink but uses markdownit() defaults; markdown.ts is absent and targeted parent-tree search finds no html: true in the Ollama/markdown path. Thus the reported raw-HTML mechanism is absent from the immediate parent.
